scripts.init: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; npx supabase@latest init --workdir "$ROOT/supabase"'
scripts.link: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; : "${SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF:?SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF is required}"; : "${SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN:?SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN is required}"; npx supabase@latest link --workdir "$ROOT/supabase" --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" --token "$SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN"'
scripts.start: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; npx supabase@latest start --workdir "$ROOT/supabase"'
scripts.stop: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; npx supabase@latest stop --workdir "$ROOT/supabase"'
scripts.typecheck: echo 'No TypeScript sources yet in supabase package'
scripts.test:db: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; npx supabase@latest test db --workdir "$ROOT/supabase"'
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run test:unit && corepack pnpm run test:db
